Your whole club. In your pocket.

Search any member. See everything. Call them in one tap.

Every parent and gymnast in your club, searchable in seconds — by admins and coaches alike. Tap a name and see their full profile in one place: contact details, emergency contacts, medical conditions and allergies, and photo permissions.

No separate contacts list to dig through. If a child needs collecting, gets hurt, or a coach just needs to check who's picking them up today, the answer — and the phone call — is one tap away, right there on the same screen. The web admin panel gives your office team the exact same search and call tools too.

Your whole club, genuinely in your pocket.

Search any member, see their full profile and call them — straight from the app

Registers, sorted.

Full register history. Every class, every date, instantly.

Coaches take the register on their phone in seconds, and it saves automatically the moment it's marked — nothing to submit, nothing to lose. Filter by day or by class to see exactly who attended, who was late and how many sessions have run.

No more paper registers, no more asking a coach what happened three weeks ago. The full history is there, for every class, every time.

On the register itself.

Allergies, medical alerts and photo permission — right there on the register.

No flicking to another screen, no asking a parent to repeat themselves. Every child's card on the register shows medical alerts, medication, special requirements and photo permission instantly — coaches see everything they need before the session even starts.

Mark attendance with a single tap. It's all saved automatically, the moment it happens.

✓Coaches can leave notes on the register, visible to other coaches and admins
✓If a parent hasn't signed a child up yet, coaches can add them straight onto the register themselves
✓Their hours are tracked from day one and link up automatically once the parent signs up

Holiday camp management

Run school holiday camps without the spreadsheets.

Create a camp, set the days, and everything else follows. Parents book and pay directly through the app. Registers are generated automatically — one per day, per child, based on exactly what they've booked. On the day, coaches take attendance on their phone exactly as they would for a normal class.

Holiday camps use the same register experience as your regular classes, so coaches don't need to learn a different system.

✓Parents book their child for specific days — or all days — and pay at the point of booking
✓Daily registers created automatically — no manual setup
✓Coaches take camp registers on their phone, just like a normal class
✓Full camp attendance history saved automatically
✓Send push notifications to camp parents instantly
✓No spreadsheets, no paper registers, no separate booking system

Our story

Built by a club parent, for club owners

Apps By Angela was built alongside the people who actually run clubs — coaches, administrators and club owners who told us exactly what they needed. What started as a solution for one gymnastics club grew into something much bigger.

Every single feature on the platform exists because a real club asked for it. Whether your members are juniors or adults, we listened, we built it, and we keep building — because club management should work the way clubs actually work.

Built independently and shaped by feedback from gymnastics clubs, Apps By Angela focuses on practical features that help clubs save time, improve communication and keep everything in one place. Every major feature has been developed in response to real feedback from club owners, coaches and parents — and the platform continues to evolve as clubs grow.

Safeguarding built in

No child ever misses their moment.

Photo consent is taken seriously. But it shouldn't mean a child misses out on being recognised for their hard work.

With Apps By Angela, if a child doesn't have photo permission, a default image is automatically used in their place. They still get recognised as Gymnast of the Month. The notification still goes out. Their achievement is still celebrated.

Every child. Every achievement. Always celebrated.

✓Photo consent tracked per child on the register
✓Default image used automatically if no consent given
✓Recognition notification still goes to all members
✓No child is ever excluded from their moment

FAQ

Common questions

Gymnastics club software helps clubs manage day-to-day admin such as attendance, class registers, parent communication, bookings, payments, registrations, coach tools and gymnast recognition. Apps By Angela gives clubs those tools inside their own branded club app.
Yes. Coaches can use the app to take attendance for classes and sessions, helping clubs keep clearer registers and manage gymnast attendance more easily.
You choose how your club takes payments. If you currently use cash or bank transfer, you can carry on exactly as you are — the app makes it easy to record and track these payments against each member. If you'd like to accept card payments too, Stripe is built in with no added markup, so every penny goes straight to your club. The choice is entirely yours.
Yes. Clubs can send parent updates and push notifications through their own branded club app, helping reduce missed messages and making communication feel more professional.
Yes — completely. Your app is fully white-labelled with your club name, logo and colour scheme. It's listed on the App Store and Google Play under your club's name. Members will never see the Apps By Angela branding.
Not at all. The platform works for any club or organisation — dance schools, martial arts, swimming clubs, football academies, cheer, community groups and more. You can customise the member label to suit your club.
Yes. Apps By Angela fully supports multiple locations under a single account. You can send notifications to specific locations and manage separate class timetables across all sites.
Coaches get their own dedicated view. You assign coaches to specific classes, and they can take registers, search members, check medical information, call parents and recognise students — all from their phone.

The helper role is perfect for parent volunteers who assist at your club. Rather than giving them full admin access, you assign them a helper role and choose exactly what they can do — managing merchandise, entering competition results, handling the waiting list, viewing registers and more. They only ever see what you allow, and sensitive areas like billing, member editing and settings are always protected. You can update their permissions at any time from one simple screen.

Absolutely. Members aged 16 and over can sign up and manage their own account directly in the app — no parent or guardian needed. This makes Apps By Angela perfect for adult gymnastics, martial arts, dance, fitness clubs and more, not just junior clubs.
